risk: MinIO AGPL-3.0 obligations may be incompatible with target commercial/private deployment
impact: Legal blocker or forced object-store replacement
mitigation: Complete legal review decide commercial license or S3-compatible replacement before Beta

risk: MinIO public Docker image cadence differs from latest source tags
impact: Security patch lag or unreproducible deployment
mitigation: Pin available image digest for dev and decide source build or supported distribution before Beta
trigger: No supported image path by P1-03

risk: SpiceDB relationships lag behind PostgreSQL canonical state
impact: Incorrect allow or deny on newly changed resources
mitigation: Use transactional outbox idempotency dead letter alerts and fail closed for sensitive operations
trigger: Outbox lag exceeds threshold or dead letters appear

risk: SpiceDB schema over-grants across org/team/project boundaries
mitigation: Maintain zed positive/negative fixtures and require schema CI on every change

risk: personal memory leaks into another member context
impact: Data leakage incident and GA blocker
mitigation: SQL scope filters owner-only SpiceDB permission and isolation test suite

risk: team_shared memory leaks across organizations during pgvector search
mitigation: Always pre-filter by org/team candidates before vector ranking and batch SpiceDB check after

risk: pgvector query latency exceeds memory prefetch P95 budget
impact: Slow chat startup and poor pilot acceptance
mitigation: Add HNSW baseline candidate limits and performance dashboard
trigger: Prefetch P95 > 500ms in P4 load test

risk: Hermes core patches for team_context or tool hooks regress existing CLI/gateway behavior
impact: Core product regression and slow merge
mitigation: Keep patches minimal feature-gated and covered by existing tests plus team tests
trigger: Existing gateway/API tests fail after P2 patches

risk: API Server trusted identity headers can be spoofed outside Team Cloud boundary
mitigation: Accept identity headers only from mTLS/service-token trusted path and fail closed by default

risk: High-risk tool calls bypass TeamToolPolicyHook through alternate execution path
mitigation: Hook agent/tool executor paths and audit all tool calls before execution

risk: Personal backup restore overwrites newer memory without user confirmation
mitigation: Restore preview staging conflict policy and user confirmation before execute

risk: Optional psycopg LGPL-3.0-only dependency enters default runtime without review
mitigation: Use asyncpg by default and require legal review before psycopg default inclusion
trigger: pyproject adds psycopg outside optional path
